name: DCT Quantization Fingerprint
description: A life sentence handed down to sloppy JPEG splicing forgers. Whenever a JPEG is saved, it is violently compressed and branded by an 8x8 quantization matrix. When a photoshopper slices a head from Image A (saved at Quality 80) and grafts it onto Image B (Quality 95), the entire spliced zone screams out forensically because its DCT quantization fingerprint violently clashes with the host environment. This algorithm aggressively exhumes the 8x8 grid to scrutinize full-frame compression history consistency.
algorithm: 8x8 DCT Block Boundary Anomaly & Double Quantization Mapping
mechanism: The algorithm slices open the visual skin to directly harvest the hidden Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) Coefficient tables buried in the file architecture. In regions containing synthetic objects (or spliced from another stream), the 8x8 spatial grid is punctured, out-of-phase, or carrying a quantization table wildly alien to the host background. This scanner targets the 8x8 block boundaries, measures peak blocking energy, and hunts for nauseatingly misaligned structural phase-shifts—the ultimate smoking gun of splicing crime.
parameters: Scanning Core: Discrete Cosine Transform 8x8 Grid, Suture Detector: Block Artifact Grid Mismatch, Channel: YCbCr Luma Sequence
accuracy: Very High (85-92%) - The Supreme Court dedicated strictly to prosecuting manipulated JPEG files that have been repeatedly opened, edited, and resaved.
source: Fan & De Queiroz (2003) - Bitmap Compression History & Block-Grained Forgery Detection
useCase: X-rays the microscopic JPEG compression macro-blocks to yank out forcibly injected picture elements, proving mathematically that the specific object originated from a foreign junk file rather than being born within the current frame.

references.title: Fan, Z. & de Queiroz, R.L. (2003). Identification of Bitmap Compression History. IEEE ICIP.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Strikes directly at the inescapable core of the international compression standard; quantization matrix phase-shifting is an indisputable computational truth.
• Boasts a near 100% lethality rate against any fraudster inserting a person into a frame who lazily fails to synthetically homogenize the raw compression blocks.
limitations:
• Utterly impotent and suicidal when facing smooth, non-blocked formats like PNG/WebP, or if the image is cropped by just 2 pixels, irreversibly detonating the global 8x8 grid alignment.
• Completely blinded if the malicious actor resaves the forged composite at a garbage-tier compression (e.g., Quality 30%)—which blankets the entire canvas in catastrophic macro-block vomit, permanently destroying all historical evidence.
